_note: SEED CONTENT — short definitions for terms not already owned by another file. Anything with a full concept, formula or method record lives there instead and is linked from here. Authored properly in Phase 12.

items.shortDef: The immediate voltage step seen when current starts or stops, equal to the current multiplied by the cell's ohmic resistance.
Constant current until a voltage limit is reached, then constant voltage while the current decays to a termination threshold.
The first cycles of a new cell, usually at low rate, during which interfacial layers such as the SEI develop and irreversible capacity is consumed.
Separate leads carry the current and measure the voltage, so lead and contact resistance are excluded from the recorded cell voltage.
The mass of electroactive material on an electrode, excluding binder, conductive additive and current collector unless explicitly stated otherwise.
